inputs.checklistItemText: Existing or future dedicated easements not shown on one or more sheets (BAS-12)
inputs.question: Are easements (such as utility easements, public easements, or drainage easements) shown on this sheet? Look for easement lines, labels, or hatching indicating easement areas.

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether easements are present/shown on the sheet at all (a feature presence and sheet-discovery check), not asking to measure dimensions, verify clearances, or inspect drawing annotations like bearings or symbols. This is a straightforward visual presence question.
